source_caption:
🎥🎬: We’re the Millers (2013)

David Clark is a small-time marijuana dealer who gets robbed and loses his stash and money. His boss offers him a way out: smuggle a large shipment of marijuana from Mexico into the United States. To make the trip look innocent, David recruits a fake family—a stripper named Rose, a troubled teenager named Kenny, and a rebellious neighbor named Casey.

Posing as the picture-perfect Millers, the unlikely group crosses the border in an RV, expecting an easy trip. Instead, they encounter drug dealers, border agents, criminals, and plenty of disasters that threaten to expose their fake identities. Along the way, the strangers unexpectedly begin to care about each other like a real family.

source_details.synopsis: We're the Millers is a 2013 American comedy road film directed by Rawson Marshall Thurber and starring Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Emma Roberts, Will Poulter, Nick Offerman, Kathryn Hahn, Molly Quinn, and Ed Helms. The film's screenplay was written by Bob Fisher, Steve Faber, Sean Anders, and John Morris, based on a story by Fisher and Faber. The plot follows a small-time pot dealer (Sudeikis) who convinces his neighbors to help him by pretending to be his family in order to smuggle drugs from Mexico into the United States.
